## About
Complete Automotive Systems is a family-owned and operated repair shop on National Blvd in West Los Angeles. We work on all makes and models, and European cars are our specialty: Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Porsche, Audi, Land Rover and more.
Our technicians are dealership-certified, and our qualifications include Bosch and ASE certifications. We use factory-certified parts and equipment, and we walk you through what's wrong and what your options are so you can decide what makes sense. You won't be pushed into work you don't need.
One longtime customer says John, our general manager, personally checks in on the progress of the work. Stop in, call, or request an appointment.

## Services
- European auto repair: Maintenance and repair for Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Porsche, Audi, Land Rover, Jaguar, MINI, Volkswagen and Bentley.
- Engine tune-ups: Tune-ups to keep a car you've had for years running the way it should.
- Oil changes: Full-service oil changes with conventional, synthetic blend or full synthetic oil.
- Transmission maintenance: Service for both automatic and manual transmissions.
- Tire services: Tire balancing, wheel alignment and other tire work.
- Cooling, fuel injection and power steering: Cooling system service, fuel injection system cleaning, power steering work and more.
- STAR smog station: We are a STAR smog station and an ASE Blue Station.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on European cars?
A: No. European makes are our specialty, but our mechanics work on foreign and domestic vehicles, including Japanese and electric cars.

Q: Can I get an estimate without coming in?
A: Yes. Fill in the quick estimate form on our site and we'll send you an estimate by email.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: We're open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM and closed on Sunday.

The prices are reasonable, and well worth the quality of service. It’s LA, so nothing is cheap, but their rates are fair for the level of service I’ve always received. John the GM is a good guy and will  personally check in on the progress. The man even took a ride with me once to identify an engine bay sound I was hearing.

Great mechanics, they diagnose the work needed in a timely fashion. I can’t remember ever having to bring the car back because they missed something, and they don't try to hard sell additional unnecessary work. I like the new online work order system they have, showing you pics of the items that need attention. They even break it down to urgent stuff and issues that can wait a bit.

I’ve recommended them to friends and would do the same for anyone who lives in the area." (Rob Groenwold, 5/5)
